lineage.strategy: Add physical capacity-expansion evidence that addresses the execution bottleneck implied by the record backlog rather than repeat backlog statistics.

observations.fact: Powell committed $12.4 million to expand its Jacintoport Houston facility by 335,000 square feet of Power Control Room laydown area, a stated 62% increase in yard capacity.

The project also doubles shoreline bulkhead length to 1,150 feet for schedule flexibility and multiple ship lanes; Powell stated the added capacity can support all market sectors despite initial oil-and-gas focus.

risks.risk: The expansion was expected to complete in late fiscal 2026; this source establishes planned capacity, not verified completion, throughput gains or conversion of current backlog into revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Current completion status, realized throughput improvement and allocation of the expanded yard to data-center versus LNG/other projects require current evidence.

recommendation: Use as evidence of deliberate physical capacity investment, but require current completion/throughput proof before treating it as resolved execution capacity.
